# Follow up on a property lead

Label a property enquiry, answer it, and send a later message only if the lead has not replied.

An agency or a broker uses Whatsable so a person who writes about a listing gets an answer, and a quiet lead gets one later message instead of a string of them.

## Set it up

**Label the enquiry**

Create labels such as Viewing or Not interested. A keyword, an ad headline, or a teammate can apply them. See [Labels](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/labels).

**Let an agent answer the first questions**

On Growth, Pro and Agency, an AI agent can answer from your listings and hand the chat to a person. See [AI agents](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot).

**Schedule one follow-up**

Schedule a template for the next day, only if they have not replied, and only if the contact does not carry Not interested. See [Conditional follow-ups](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/conditional-follow-ups).

**Route it to the right person**

Limit a Member to the labels they work. There is no assignee field. See [Route conversations to the right teammate](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/chat-assignment).

**Notify the people who can see it**

A handoff notifies the teammates who can open that conversation. See [Notifications](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/notifications).

The AI agent is on Growth, Pro and Agency. A lead that starts from a Click-to-WhatsApp ad can take the ad's headline as its label.

## FAQ

**Does a follow-up go out after they book a viewing?**

Not if the condition excludes the Viewing label, or if they already replied. The check runs when the message is due.

**Where does an ad lead show?**

The inbox shows an Ad badge. The label is the ad headline when that switch is on. See [Lead from an ad](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/how-it-fits-together#lead-from-an-ad).
